grammar_archive.topic: Linking adverbials - sabab, natija, qo'shimcha va qarama-qarshilik (therefore, however, moreover, consequently)

parts.1: 📌 Linking Adverbials: Fikrlarni bog'lash san'ati (1/5-qism) Ingliz tilida gaplarni bir-biriga mantiqan bog'lash va fikrni ravon yetkazish uchun linking adverbials (bog'lovchi ravishlar) qo'llaniladi. Ular yozma va og'zaki nutqda sabab, natija, qo'shimcha fikr hamda qarama-qarshilikni ko'rsatish uchun xizmat qiladi. Therefore, however, moreover va consequently kabi so'zlar nutqimizni yanada boyitadi va fikrni akademik darajada ifodalashga yordam beradi. Ushbu bog'lovchilar yordamida murakkab va mantiqli jumlalar tuzish ancha osonlashadi. 📖 Oddiy misollar: • She studied hard; therefore, she passed the exam easily. (U qattiq o'qidi; shuning uchun u imtihondan oson o'tdi.) • The weather was cold; however, we went for a walk. (Havo sovuq edi; shunga qaramay, biz sayrga chiqdik.) 💡 Eslatma: Ushbu seriyamizning keyingi qismlarida sabab, natija, qo'shimcha fikr va qarama-qarshilik bog'lovchilarining gapdagi o'rni, darak hamda inkor holatlardagi tuzilishi va tinish belgilari qo'llanilishini alohida ko'rib chiqamiz. Kanallimizni kuzatib boring!
parts.2: 📌 Grammar Time: Linking Adverbials (2/5) 📖 Bugun fikrlarni mantiqan bog'laydigan linking adverbials (bog'lovchi ravishlar) ning darak gaplardagi qo'llanish tartibini o'rganamiz. ⚡ Darak gap tuzilishi: 1-mustaqil gap + . / ; + Linking Adverbial + , + 2-mustaqil gap 📝 Misollar: 🔹 However (qarama-qarshilik): The weather was terrible; however, we decided to go hiking. (Ob-havo juda yomon edi; shunday bo'lsa-da, biz sayrga chiqishga qaror qildik.) 🔹 Therefore (natija): She studied hard for the exam. Therefore, she got the highest mark. (U imtihonga qunt bilan tayyorlandi. Shuning uchun, u eng yuqori ball oldi.) 🔹 Moreover (qo'shimcha): The new laptop is lightweight. Moreover, it has a long battery life. (Yangi noutbuk juda yengil. Buning ustiga, uning batareyasi uzoqqa yetadi.) 🔹 Consequently (sabab-natija): He missed the last train. Consequently, he had to take a taxi. (U oxirgi poyezdga kechikdi. Natijada, u taksi tutishga majbur bo'ldi.) 💡 Muhim eslatma: Ushbu bog'lovchi ravishlardan so'ng har doim vergul (,) ishlatiladi. Ularni oddiy bog'lovchilar (but, and, so) kabi nuqtasiz yoki nuqtali vergulsiz to'g'ridan-to'g'ri gap o'rtasiga qo'yib bo'lmaydi.
parts.3: 📌 Linking Adverbials: Inkor gaplarda qo'llanishi (3/5-qism) 💡 Bog'lovchi ravishlar (therefore, however, moreover, consequently) inkor gaplar bilan kelganda, sodir bo'lmagan hodisalar yoki salbiy natijalarni bog'lash uchun xizmat qiladi. ✅ Inkor gap formulasi: 1-gap + [Linking Adverbial] + Subject + auxiliary verb + not + Verb 📖 Misollar: 1. He studied very hard; however, he didn't pass the final exam. (U juda qattiq tayyorlandi; biroq, yakuniy imtihondan o'ta olmadi.) 2. The weather was awful; therefore, we could not start our journey. (Ob-havo juda yomon edi; shu sababli, biz safarimizni boshlay olmadik.) 3. The company lost money; consequently, they did not hire new staff. (Kompaniya zarar ko'rdi; natijada, ular yangi xodimlarni ishga olishmadi.) 4. The car is too old; moreover, it doesn't run smoothly. (Mashina juda eski; qolaversa, u yaxshi yurmaydi.) ❗ Tez-tez uchraydigan xato: Bog'lovchi ravishdan so'ng kelgan inkor gapda yordamchi fe'lni tushirib qoldirmang (masalan, "however he not came" emas, "however, he didn't come" bo'ladi). Shuningdek, however yoki therefore kabi so mezonli ravishlardan keyin har doim vergul (,) qo'yilishini unutmang.
parts.4: 📖 Linking Adverbials: So'roq gaplarda qo'llanishi (4/5) 📌 Linking Adverbials (therefore, however, moreover, consequently) ko'pincha oldingi fikrga bog'langan holda mantiqiy savol berish uchun ishlatiladi. 💡 Umumiy so'roq gap (Yes/No questions) formulasi: [Darak gap]; Linking Adverbial + Yordamchi fe'l + Ega + Asosiy fe'l ...? 💡 Maxsus so'roq gap (Wh- questions) formulasi: [Darak gap]; Linking Adverbial + Wh-so'z + Yordamchi fe'l + Ega + Fe'l ...? 📝 Misol jumlalar: 🔹 The weather was terrible; however, did you enjoy your trip? (Ob-havo juda yomon edi; shunga qaramay, sayohatingizdan rohatlandingizmi?) 🔹 The sales decreased this month; therefore, should we change our strategy? (Bu oy sotuvlar kamaydi; shu sababli, strategiyamizni o'zgartirishimiz kerakmi?) 🔹 The product is very expensive; moreover, why is its quality so poor? (Mahsulot juda qimmat; ustiga-akasi, nega uning sifati bunchalik yomon?) 🔹 He missed the final deadline; consequently, what will happen to his project? (U yakuniy muddatni o'tkazib yubordi; natijada, uning loyihasi nima bo'ladi?) ❗ Eslatma: Yozma nutqda ushbu bog'lovchi so me'yorida ikki gap o'rtasida nuqtali vergul (;) va o'zidan keyin vergul (,) bilan ajratib yoziladi.

grammar_archive.topic: Present Perfect Continuous (hozirgacha davom etayotgan harakatning davomiyligini ta'kidlash)

parts.1: 🇬🇧 Present Perfect Continuous zamoni bilan tanishamiz! (1/5-qism) 📌 Ushbu zamon o'tmishda boshlangan va hozirgi paytgacha to'xtovsiz davom etayotgan harakatlarni ifodalash uchun ishlatiladi. Bu yerda asosiy e'tibor harakatning yakunlanganiga emas, balki uning qancha vaqt davom etganiga qaratiladi. Agar siz biror ishni qanchadan beri qilayotganingizni alohida ta'kidlamoqchi bo'lsangiz, aynan shu grammatik zamondan foydalanasiz. O'zbek tiliga bu zamon ko'pincha "...dan beri qilmoqdaman" yoki "... buyon bajarayapman" shaklida tarjima qilinadi. 📖 Misollar: 🗣️ I have been studying English for three years. (Men uch yildan beri ingliz tilini o'rganmoqdaman.) 🗣️ She has been reading this book since morning. (U ertalabdan beri ushbu kitobni o'qiyapti.) 📝 Seriyamizning keyingi qismlarida ushbu zamonning darak, inkor va so'roq gap tuzilishlarini batafsil ko'rib chiqamiz. Bizni kuzatishda davom eting!
parts.2: ⏳ Present Perfect Continuous: Darak gaplar (2/5-qism) Harakat o'tmishda boshlanib, hozirgacha davom etayotganini hamda uning davomiyligini ta'kidlash uchun ushbu zamondan foydalanamiz. 📌 Darak gap formulasi: Subject + have / has + been + V-ing • I / You / We / They + have been + V-ing • He / She / It + has been + V-ing 📝 Misollar: • I have been studying English for three years. (Men uch yildan beri ingliz tilini o'rganmoqdaman.) • She has been reading this book since morning. (U ertalabdan beri ushbu kitobni o'qiyapti.) • They have been waiting for the bus for 30 minutes. (Ular 30 daqiqadan beri avtobus kutishmoqda.) • It has been raining all day. (Kun bo'yi yomg'ir yog'moqda.) 💡 Tez-tez uchraydigan xato: Jumla tuzishda been ko'makchi fe'lini tushirib qoldirish eng katta xatolardan biridir. Har doim have/has dan so'ng been va fe'lga -ing qo'shimchasini qo'shishni unutmang. Xato: I have working here for 5 years. ❌ To'g'ri: I have been working here for 5 years. ✅

grammar_archive.topic: Reported speech - fe'l zamoni, olmosh va vaqt ifodalarining o'zgarishi

parts.1: 📌 Reported Speech: O'zlashtirma gaplar va ularning asosiy qoidalari (1/5) 🗣️ Reported speech (o'zlashtirma gap) – bu biror kishining aytgan gapini o'zgalarga yetkazish uchun ishlatiladigan grammatik konstruktsiyadir. Kundalik muloqotda va yozishmada biz tez-tez kimmizdir aytgan fikrini boshqalarga so'zlab beramiz. Ushbu qoidada eng muhim narsa shundaki, gap o'zlashtirilganda fe'l zamonlari bir bosqich o'tmishga suriladi, olmoshlar va vaqt ifodalari esa vaziyatga qarab o'zgaradi. Bu muloqotimiz aniq va savodli bo'lishini ta'minlaydi. 📖 Misollarga e'tibor bering: Direct: "I am happy," she said. Reported: She said that she was happy. (U o'zining baxtli ekanini aytdi.) Direct: "We live here," they said. Reported: They said that they lived there. (Ular u yerda yashashlarini aytishdi.) 💡 Ushbu 5 qismli seriyamizning keyingi darslarida darak, inkor va so'roq gap birikmalarida zamon hamda olmoshlarning o'zgarishini batafsil ko'rib chiqamiz. Bizni kuzatib boring!
parts.2: 📌 Reported Speech: Darak gaplarda zamon va olmoshlar o'zgarishi (2/5) 📖 O'zlashtirma gapda (Reported Speech) darak gaplarni hosil qilish uchun to'g'ri gapdagi fe'l zamoni bir bosqich orqaga suriladi, olmoshlar hamda vaqt ko'rsatkichlari mazmunga qarab o'zgaradi. 💡 Darak gap formulasi: Subject + said / told (someone) + (that) + Subject + Verb (past tense) 🗣️ Misollar: 1. Direct: "I live in Tashkent," Malika said. Reported: Malika said that she lived in Tashkent. (Malika Toshkentda yashashini aytdi.) 2. Direct: "We are playing football now," the boys said. Reported: The boys said that they were playing football then. (Bolalar o'sha paytda futbol o'ynashayotganini aytishdi.) 3. Direct: "I have visited Samarkand," Aziz told me. Reported: Aziz told me that he had visited Samarkand. (Aziz menga Samarqandga borganini aytdi.) 4. Direct: "I will help you tomorrow," Sardor said. Reported: Sardor said that he would help me the next day. (Sardor ertasiga menga yordam berishini aytdi.) ❗ Keng tarqalgan xato: said fe'lidan so'ng to'g'ridan-to me/him/her kabi to'ldiruvchilar kelmaydi. Masalan, He said me deyish xatodir. O'rniga said to me yoki told me deb ishlatish kerak.
parts.3: 📌 Reported Speech: Inkor gaplar (3/5-qism) 🗣️ O'zgalar gapida inkor jumlalarni (Negative sentences) yetkazishda ham asosiy qoida saqlanadi: fe'l zamoni bir zamon ortga suriladi va inkor shakli saqlab qolinadi. 📝 Inkor gap tuzilish formulasi: To'g'ri gap: Subject + auxiliary verb + not + Verb O'zgalar gapi: Subject + said / told + (that) + Subject + past auxiliary verb + not + Verb (Masalan: don't/doesn't ➡️ didn't, haven't/hasn't ➡️ hadn't, won't ➡️ wouldn't) 📖 Misollar: 1. Direct: "I don't like cold water," Rustam said. Reported: Rustam said that he didn't like cold water. (Rustam sovuq suvni yoqtirmasligini aytdi.) 2. Direct: "We haven't completed the task yet," they told us. Reported: They told us that they hadn't completed the task by then. (Ular o'sha vaqtgacha topshiriqni hali bajarishmaganini aytishdi.) 3. Direct: "I won't call him tomorrow," Anora said. Reported: Anora said that she wouldn't call him the next day. (Anora ertasi kuni unga qo'ng'iroq qilmasligini aytdi.) 4. Direct: "He isn't studying now," she said. Reported: She said that he wasn't studying then. (U yigit o'sha paytda dars qilmayotganini aytdi.) ❗ Muhim eslatma: Inkor gaplarni o'zgartirayotganda yordamchi fe'l zamonini o'zgarishsiz qoldirish eng ko'p uchraydigan xatodir (masalan, don't o'rniga didn't ishlatilishi shart). Shuningdek, zamon o'zgarishi bilan birga olmoshlar hamda vaqt ko'rsatkichlari (now ➡️ then, tomorrow ➡️ the next day) o'zgarishini ham doimo yodda tuting!

grammar_archive.topic: Reported speech - buyruq, iltimos va savollarni ko'chirish

parts.1: 📌 Reported Speech: Buyruq, iltimos va savollarni ko'chirish (1/5-qism) 📖 Kunlik muloqotimizda boshqalarning aytgan gaplarini, buyruqlarini yoki so'ragan iltimoslarini kimgadir yetkazishimizga to'g'ri keladi. O'zbek tilida bu o'zlashtirma gap deb ataladi va ingliz tilida bu hodisa Reported Speech orqali ifodalanadi. Boshqalarning so'zlarini o'zgartirib yetkazishda fe'l shakllari va bog'lovchilardan to'g me'yorda foydalanish juda muhim. Ushbu qoidani egallash nutqingizni yanada boy, tushunarli hamda ravon qilishga yordam beradi. 📝 Oddiy misollar: 🗣️ Direct: "Open the window, please." ✅ Reported: He asked me to open the window. (U mendan oynani ochishimni iltimos qildi.) 🗣️ Direct: "Where do you live?" ✅ Reported: She asked me where I lived. (U mendan qayerda yashashimni so'radi.) 💡 Keyingi qismlarda nimalarni o'rganamiz? Ushbu seriyamizning keyingi sonlarida buyruq va iltimoslarning darak hamda inkor shakllarini, shuningdek, turli so'roq gaplarni ko'chirish tuzilishini alohida va batafsil ko'rib chiqamiz. Bizni kuzatib boring!
parts.2: 📌 Reported Speech: Buyruq va iltimoslar (2/5-qism) 💡 To'g'ridan-to me'yoriy buyruq va iltimoslarni o'zlashtirma gapga o'tkazishda zamonlar o'zgarmaydi, balki fe'l oldiga to yuklamasi qo'shiladi. 📖 Darak gap formulasi: Subject + tell / ask / order + object + to + Verb Eslatma: Iltimoslar uchun ask, buyruqlar uchun tell yoki order fe'llari ishlatiladi. 📝 Misollar: 🗣️ Direct: "Open the window, please," she said. ✅ Reported: She asked me to open the window. (U mendan derazani ochishni iltimos qildi.) 🗣️ Direct: "Sit down!" the teacher said to us. ✅ Reported: The teacher told us to sit down. (O'qituvchi bizga o'tirishni aytdi.) 🗣️ Direct: "Clean your room," my mom said. ✅ Reported: My mom told me to clean my room. (Onam menga xonamni tozalashni aytdi.) 🗣️ Direct: "Please help me with this task," Tom said. ✅ Reported: Tom asked me to help him with that task. (Tom ushbu topshiriqda unga yordam berishimni iltimos qildi.) ❗ Tez-tez uchraydigan xato: Ko'chirilgan gapda please so'zi tushirib qoldiriladi. Shuningdek, tell fe me'yorida to'g'ridan-to'g'ri to'ldiruvchi keladi (masalan: told to me emas, told me bo'ladi).
parts.3: 📌 Reported Speech: Inkor buyruq va iltimoslar (3/5-qism) 🗣️ O'zlashtirma gapda inkor shaklidagi buyruq yoki iltimoslarni ko'chirishda don't so'zi tushirib qoldiriladi va uning o'rniga not to + fe'l birikmasi ishlatiladi. 📝 Inkor shakl formulasi: Subject + told/asked + Object + NOT TO + V1 ✅ Misollar: 1. Direct: "Don't open the window," he said. Reported: He asked me not to open the window. (U mendan darchani ochmaslikni iltimos qildi.) 2. Direct: "Don't be late!" the teacher said. Reported: The teacher told us not to be late. (O'qituvchi bizga kechikmaslikni aytdi.) 3. Direct: "Please don't touch my phone," she said. Reported: She asked him not to touch her phone. (U undan telefoniga tegmaslikni iltimos qildi.) 4. Direct: "Don't make noise!" my mom said. Reported: My mom told me not to make noise. (Onam menga shovqin solmaslikni tayinladi.) 💡 Muhim eslatma: Tez-tez uchraydigan xato — to not deb yozishdir. Esda tuting, inkor yuklamasi har doim to dan oldin keladi, ya'ni to'g'ri shakli not to hisoblanadi.
parts.4: 📌 Reported Speech: So'roq gaplarni ko'chirish (4/5) 🗣️ So'roq gaplarni o'zlashtirma gapga o'tkazganda so'roq so'z tartibi yo'qoladi va gap darak gap shakliga o'tadi. Zamonlar esa odatiy qoida bo'yicha bir qadam orqaga suriladi. 📖 1. Umumiy so'roq gaplar (Yes/No questions): Bunday gaplarni bog'lash uchun if yoki whether so'zlaridan foydalaniladi: Ega + asked + if / whether + ega + fe'l... 📖 2. Maxsus so'roq gaplar (Wh- questions): So'roq so'zlari (where, what, why, how va h.k.) o'z o'rnida saqlanadi: Ega + asked + Wh-so'z + ega + fe'l... 📝 Misollar: • "Do you speak English?" she asked. She asked if I spoke English. (U inglizcha gapirishimni so'radi.) • "Are you ready?" he asked me. He asked me whether I was ready. (U mendan tayyor ekanligimni so'radi.) • "Where do you live?" Tom asked. Tom asked where I lived. (Tom qayerda yashashimni so'radi.) • "What are you searching for?" she asked him. She asked him what he was searching for. (U undan nima qidirayotganini so'radi.) 💡 Muhim eslatma: O'zlashtirma so'roq gaplarda do, does, did yordamchi fe'llari tushib qoladi va gap oxiriga so'roq belgisi o'rniga nuqta qo'yiladi.
parts.5: 📌 Reported speech: Amaliyot va yakun (5/5-qism) 💡 E'tibor bering! Ko'p yo'l qo'yiladigan xatolar: 1. Savol so'z tartibi: O'zlashtirma savollarda yordamchi fe'l egadan oldinga o'tmaydi, ya'ni darak gap tartibi saqlanadi. Masalan, where was he emas, where he was bo'ladi. 2. Buyruqlarda 'that' ishlatish: Buyruq va iltimoslarni ko'chirishda that emas, to + fe'l (inkorda not to + fe'l) ishlatiladi. Masalan, He told me that go emas, He told me to go bo'ladi. 📝 Amaliy mashq: Bo'sh joylarni to'g me shakl bilan to'ldiring: 1. "Don't touch the wire!" -> He warned me ___ the wire. 2. "Where do you live?" -> She asked me where I ___. 3. "Can you help me?" -> He asked Sarah if she ___ help him. 4. "Please close the window." -> Mom asked me ___ the window. ✅ Javoblar: 1. not to touch (Inkor buyruqlar not to + fe'l ko'rinishida bo'ladi) 2. lived (Darak gap tartibi hamda zamon surilishi: Present Simple -> Past Simple) 3. could (Modal fe'llar zamoni suriladi: can -> could) 4. to close (Iltimos gaplarni ko'chirishda to + fe'l ishlatiladi)
